purpose: Bind fixed-role grants to real workforce people and their own Assignments, and make grant revocation irreversible.
lockImpact: Validates two foreign keys and installs a row trigger on fixed_role_grants; no table rewrite is expected in the reset local environment.
dataImpact: No row changes; inconsistent grant rows or attempted revocation reversal fail closed.
backfill: Not required for the reset development database. Pre-existing inconsistent rows must be removed before applying this migration.
recovery: A reviewed emergency migration may drop the trigger and foreign keys before rolling back to a runtime that predates fixed roles.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed authorization-owned migration. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
